systems_auto._default: auto-populated by taking each *.lmp file in the user_files directory

nnp_program._comment: str, "deepmd" or "mace" - selects the NNP architecture for the whole procedure, set once here

validation/training_split._comment: float, fraction of the labeled data set aside for validation (the rest is used for training)

data_format._comment: str, "set.000" (nnp_program: deepmd) or "extxyz" (nnp_program: mace) - storage format of the training data
